title: Logistics // Long-Term Intern
desc:
Delta, founded in 1971, is a global provider of power and thermal management solutions. Its mission statement, "To provide innovative, clean and energy-efficient solutions for a better tomorrow," focuses on addressing key environmental issues such as global climate change. As an energy-saving solutions provider with core competencies in power electronics and automation, Delta's business categories include Power Electronics, Mobility, Automation, and Infrastructure.
Delta Electronics has been operating in Türkiye for over 16 years in the telecommunications field with its own organization. In the field of industrial automation, it has been successfully represented by its partners for 15 years. Since 2016, it has continued its work in the field of industrial automation as " Delta Electronics Türkiye."
We are currently looking for a
Long-Term Intern
to join our Logistics team and actively support our day-to-day operations.
Job Qualifications
Currently pursuing a degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or International Trade,
Able to work from the office and continue the internship for at least 10 months,
Interested in developing a career in logistics and supply chain,
Good command of English,
Proficient in MS Office applications, particularly Excel,
Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills,
Responsible, detail-oriented, and able to follow up on tasks effectively,
Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset,
Open to learning and development,
Based on the Anatolian Side of Istanbul.
Job Responsibilities
Assist with the daily follow-up of customs and logistics operations,
Coordinate and communicate with third-party logistics service providers and warehouse partners on operational matters,
Perform data entry related to logistics processes in SAP and Logo and ensure records are kept up to date,
Contribute to order management processes when needed,
Assist in the preparation of periodic and ad-hoc reports,
Take part in the logistics team's daily operations and other activities as needed.
What will this role offer you?
You will experience the logistics operations of a global company, learn about customs, warehousing and third-party logistics processes, develop practical skills in SAP and Logo, and work with colleagues across the organization.
Most importantly, this role will help you turn your academic knowledge into real business experience and build a strong foundation for your future career in logistics and supply chain.
